system.description:
At 8th level, your chosen reputation expands, for good or for ill.

Buscadero: You have picked up enough bits and bobs here and there to gain proficiency in Thieves’ Cant. In addition, when you take the Gather Information downtime activity, you may roll a gambling check each week. Whenever you roll a 15 or higher, you can reduce your total by 5 to reduce the remaining time needed to gather information by 1 week, so long as the wager is 100gp or more.

Outlaw: Your reputation garners you favor in the underworld. When you take the Illegal Work downtime activity, you cannot fail the check by 10 or more. In addition, if you have followers, you gain an additional 50% reward from the Robbery journey activity.

White Hat: You no longer have to pay for a moderate lifestyle, as people are ever willing to take you in. A rich lifestyle costs you only 6 silver per day, if you prefer. In addition, if you take the Recovery downtime activity, there is always someone willing to use a healer’s satchel on your behalf in any non-hostile community.
